blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Port giant International Container Terminal Services Inc. (ICTSI) has bought out the minority shareholder in its Brazilian logistics subsidiary, giving it full control of a business spanning warehousing, distribution and transportation. In a disclosure on Friday, the Enrique Razon Jr.-led company said it had signed an agreement to acquire the remaining 30-percent stake […]...
